name: Synthetic customer support drafting assistant
purpose: Draft replies from customer tickets and internal knowledge articles; a support specialist remains responsible for sending replies.
business_value: Hypothesis: reduce drafting time while preserving accuracy. Compare a limited pilot against manual handling, including review effort and correction rates.

data_flows.description: Synthetic customer text that may contain adversarial instructions
Retrieved internal guidance; trust declaration needs validation against ingestion permissions
Prompt containing the ticket and selected guidance
Generated draft and suggested ticket actions
Apply a ticket update after declared specialist review; enforcement is not verified

controls.evidence: Synthetic design claim only; no approval enforcement test has been supplied
